summary: Iteration 6 verifies (1) Group Admin Tools and (2) Read Receipts Privacy. 20/20 backend tests PASSED in /app/backend/tests/test_group_admin_receipts.py. Coverage: ChatOut.created_by present; PATCH /api/chats/{id} name — admin renames (200 + GET verified), non-admin 403, direct-chat 400, empty body 400; PATCH avatar_path — admin sets & clears (empty string -> null), non-admin 403; POST /chats/{id}/members — admin adds new (200, uid in member_ids), duplicates filtered (400 when all dup), unknown uuid 400 with 'tidak ditemukan', non-admin 403; DELETE /chats/{id}/members/{mid} — admin removes non-admin member (200 & persisted), self-leave by regular member 200 (GET confirms removal), non-admin cannot remove other 403, admin self-leave via same admin endpoint returns 200 because is_self_leave branch takes priority; UserOut.read_receipts_enabled defaults true for new users and PATCH /auth/me { read_receipts_enabled:false } persists via GET /auth/me; Privacy on GET /chats/{id}/messages — when A has receipts off and A GETs, A's read_by view still contains A (self view) but B's GET does NOT contain A in read_by; regression: with receipts on, A appears in B's read_by. WebSocket 'read' event: when A has receipts off, B listening on /api/ws does not receive any {type:'read',user_id:A}; with receipts on, B receives it. Rate-limit avoided via unique per-phone timestamps. Frontend spot check: /(tabs)/settings rendered with testID='read-receipts-toggle' visible (Switch). Source review of /app/frontend/app/chat/[id]/info.tsx confirms testIDs group-info-screen, edit-group-name, group-name-input, save-group-name, add-member-btn, remove-{id}, leave-group-btn, group-avatar-picker, and admin/non-admin conditional rendering gates (isAdmin && …) on camera badge, pencil, add-member-btn, and remove-{id}. Chat header (/app/frontend/app/chat/[id].tsx:233) uses testID='chat-header-info' and navigates via router.push({pathname:'/chat/[id]/info', params:{id}}) only when chat.kind==='group'. Full navigational Playwright flow could not authenticate because auth-context persists token via SecureStore (not raw localStorage), so injected localStorage token yielded 401s; that is a test-harness limitation, not a bug in the app.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event startup/shutdown; migrate to FastAPI lifespan handler.
server.py is ~1006 lines; consider splitting into routers/services modules (>700-line guideline).
In /app/frontend/app/chat/[id]/info.tsx the divider logic `(isAdmin || i > 0) && i > 0` is redundant (always equals `i > 0`); harmless but confusing.
add_members uses $addToSet with $each so even the pre-validation 'existing filtered' is guaranteed, but the 400 on all-duplicate is user-facing correct.

PATCH /chats/{id} avatar_path max_length=512 accepts arbitrary strings not tied to /api/files; consider validating the path belongs to files collection to prevent stale/foreign path storage (low risk since download endpoint already gates on files record + membership).

success_rate.frontend: spot-checked (settings toggle rendered; info-screen navigation not exercised end-to-end due to token-storage harness limitation)

seed_data_creation: Four fresh users A/B/C/D created via OTP dev_code flow with timestamp+suffix phones (per-phone 30s cooldown avoided).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=<public url> pytest backend/tests/test_group_admin_receipts.py -n 0 --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/iter6_results.xml . Uses websockets lib for the WS-privacy assertions. For UI navigation into authenticated screens, prefer driving through the actual OTP login flow rather than injecting tokens into localStorage — auth-context on web uses expo-secure-store polyfill, not window.localStorage, so localStorage-injected tokens return 401 on /api/*. The Playwright-based settings visit succeeded because the Switch element is rendered regardless of hydrated user (defaults to true), but the toggle callback failed silently with 401.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Features implemented as spec'd.
